105	        capabilities[name] = CapabilitySnapshot(

138	            "tasks_completed": progress.tasks_completed,
139	            "review_cycle": progress.review_cycle,

160	def _capability_decision(after: ProgressSnapshot) -> SupervisorDecision | None:
161	    pending = sorted(
162	        name
163	        for name, capability in after.capabilities.items()
164	        if capability.required and capability.status == "pending"
165	    )
166	    if pending:
167	        if after.completed_prds == 0:
168	            return SupervisorDecision(
169	                DecisionKind.SKIP_CAPABILITIES,
170	                "No completed work needs capabilities",
171	            )
172	        return SupervisorDecision(
173	            DecisionKind.RUN_CAPABILITY,
174	            "Required capability is pending",
175	            capability=pending[0],
176	        )
177	    if any(
178	        capability.required and capability.status == "failed"
179	        for capability in after.capabilities.values()
180	    ):
181	        return SupervisorDecision(DecisionKind.HALT, "Required capability failed")
182	    if any(
183	        capability.status == "running" for capability in after.capabilities.values()
184	    ):
185	        return SupervisorDecision(DecisionKind.HALT, "Capability is still running")
186	    return None

189	def _failure_decision(
190	    result: AttemptResult,
191	    retries: RetryState,
192	    policy: SupervisorPolicy,
193	    now: datetime,
194	    prd: str | None,
195	) -> SupervisorDecision | None:
196	    failure = result.summary.failure_class
197	    if failure == FailureClass.RATE_LIMIT:
198	        reset = result.summary.rate_limit_reset_at
199	        if (
200	            retries.rate_limit < policy.rate_limit_retries
201	            and reset is not None
202	            and reset.utcoffset() is not None
203	        ):
204	            delay = (reset - now).total_seconds()
205	            if 0 < delay <= policy.rate_limit_wait_seconds:
206	                return SupervisorDecision(
207	                    DecisionKind.WAIT,
208	                    "Waiting for rate-limit reset",
209	                    wait_seconds=delay,
210	                )
211	        return SupervisorDecision(
212	            DecisionKind.HALT, "No bounded rate-limit retry remains"
213	        )
214	    if failure == FailureClass.CONNECTIVITY:
215	        if retries.connectivity < policy.connectivity_retries:
216	            return SupervisorDecision(
217	                DecisionKind.WAIT,
218	                "Waiting to retry connectivity",
219	                wait_seconds=policy.connectivity_wait_seconds,
220	            )
221	        return SupervisorDecision(DecisionKind.HALT, "Connectivity retries exhausted")
222	    if failure in {FailureClass.PERMISSION, FailureClass.AUTHENTICATION}:
223	        return SupervisorDecision(DecisionKind.HALT, "Session requires operator access")
224	    if not result.summary.success:
225	        if retries.died < policy.died_retries:
226	            return SupervisorDecision(
227	                DecisionKind.RETRY, "Retrying unsuccessful session"
228	            )
229	        return SupervisorDecision(
230	            DecisionKind.PARK if prd else DecisionKind.HALT,
231	            "Unsuccessful session retries exhausted",
232	        )
233	    return None
234	
235	
236	def boundary_decision(after: ProgressSnapshot) -> SupervisorDecision | None:
237	    """Apply committed controls before launching work or completing a drain."""
238	    if after.pause_requested or after.phase == "paused" or after.next_phase == "paused":
239	        return SupervisorDecision(DecisionKind.PAUSE, "Workflow is paused")
240	    if after.attention is not None:
241	        return SupervisorDecision(DecisionKind.HALT, "Workflow needs attention")
242	    if after.drained:
243	        return _capability_decision(after) or SupervisorDecision(
244	            DecisionKind.COMPLETE, "Workflow and capabilities ended"
245	        )
246	    return None
247	
248	
249	def decide(
250	    before: ProgressSnapshot,
251	    result: AttemptResult,
252	    retries: RetryState,
253	    policy: SupervisorPolicy,
254	    *,
255	    now: datetime,
256	) -> SupervisorDecision:
257	    """Choose one action in precedence order without performing side effects."""
258	    after = result.state_after
259	    if after is None or result.state_error is not None:
260	        return SupervisorDecision(DecisionKind.HALT, "Post-session state is unreadable")
261	    boundary = boundary_decision(after)
262	    if boundary is not None:
263	        return boundary
264	
265	    if _fingerprint(before) != _fingerprint(after):
266	        return SupervisorDecision(
267	            DecisionKind.CONTINUE,
268	            "Committed workflow progress",
269	            next_phase_repeats=0,
270	        )
271	    repeats = (
272	        before.phase_repeats if before.phase_fingerprint == _fingerprint(before) else 0
273	    ) + 1
274	    failure_decision = _failure_decision(result, retries, policy, now, after.prd)
275	    if failure_decision is not None and (
276	        failure_decision.kind == DecisionKind.HALT
277	        or repeats < policy.phase_repeat_limit
278	    ):
279	        return replace(failure_decision, next_phase_repeats=repeats)
280	    if repeats < policy.phase_repeat_limit:
281	        kind = DecisionKind.RETRY
282	    else:
283	        kind = (
284	            DecisionKind.PARK
285	            if after.prd
286	            else (DecisionKind.PAUSE if result.summary.success else DecisionKind.HALT)
287	        )
288	    return SupervisorDecision(
289	        kind, "Session made no workflow progress", next_phase_repeats=repeats
290	    )

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CapabilityExecution:
    success: bool
    session_id: str
    detail: str | None


class CapabilityRunner(Protocol):
    def run(self, request: CapabilityRequest) -> CapabilityExecution: ...


def _timestamp(moment: datetime) -> str:
    return moment.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _session_paths(paths: RuntimePaths, session_id: str) -> SessionPaths:
    root = paths.sessions / session_id
    return SessionPaths(
        root=root,
        raw=root / "raw.jsonl",
        normalized=root / "normalized.jsonl",
        metrics=root / "metrics.jsonl",
        metadata=root / "meta.json",
        summary=root / "summary.json",
    )


class CapabilityService:
    """Run required batch capabilities as durable, evidence-backed attempts."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        root: Path,
        *,
        store: StateStore,
        paths: RuntimePaths,
        run_id: str,
        clock: Callable[[], datetime],
        timeout_seconds: object = _DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
    ) -> None:
        self._root = root
        self._store = store
        self._state = StateService(store)
        self._paths = paths
        self._run_id = run_id
        self._clock = clock
        self._timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds
        if timeout_seconds is not _DEFAULT_TIMEOUT:
            validate_capability_timeout(timeout_seconds)

    def start(
        self, name: str, *, expected_revision: int | None = None
    ) -> CapabilityAttempt:
        """Commit a pending capability as running, then create its evidence."""
        attempt, _ = self._begin(name, self._state.start_capability, expected_revision)
        return attempt

    def finish(
        self,
        name: str,
        attempt_id: str,
        execution: CapabilityExecution,
        *,
        expected_revision: int | None = None,
    ) -> State:
        """Commit the current attempt's result, then finalize its evidence."""
        current = self._store.read()
        attempt = current["batch"]["capabilities"][name]["attempts"][-1:]
        if (
            attempt
            and attempt[0]["id"] == attempt_id
            and attempt[0]["session_id"] != execution.session_id
        ):
            raise ValueError("execution does not match the running session")
        # Pinning the observed revision keeps the session check atomic.
        state = self._state.finish_capability(
            name,
            attempt_id,
            succeeded=execution.success,
            detail=execution.detail,
            finished_at=_timestamp(self._clock()),
            expected_revision=(
                current["revision"] if expected_revision is None else expected_revision
            ),
        )
        session = _session_paths(self._paths, execution.session_id)
        descriptor = os.open(session.raw, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_APPEND | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "ab") as stream:
            stream.write((json.dumps(asdict(execution)) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        self._finalize(state, name, session)
        return state

    def reconcile(self, name: str) -> State:
        """Fail a running attempt whose recorded owner process is gone."""
        state = self._store.read()
        capability = state["batch"]["capabilities"][name]
        if capability["status"] != "running":
            return state
        attempt = capability["attempts"][-1]
        assert attempt["session_id"] is not None
        session = _session_paths(self._paths, attempt["session_id"])
        try:
            metadata = parse_session_metadata(json.loads(session.metadata.read_text()))
            if process_matches(ProcessIdentity(metadata.pid, metadata.process_start)):
                return state
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            pass  # Unreadable ownership evidence cannot prove a live owner.
        state = self._state.reconcile_capability(
            name,
            attempt["id"],
            detail=f"owner process exited; retry {name} explicitly",
            finished_at=_timestamp(self._clock()),
            expected_revision=state["revision"],
        )
        self._finalize(state, name, session)
        return state

    def retry(self, name: str, runner: CapabilityRunner) -> State:
        """Run exactly one new attempt for a failed or stale capability."""
        if self.reconcile(name)["batch"]["capabilities"][name]["status"] == "running":
            raise ValueError(f"capability {name!r} is still running")
        return self._execute(name, runner, self._state.retry_capability)

    def run(self, name: str, runner: CapabilityRunner) -> State:
        """Run exactly one pending capability through the shared lifecycle."""
        return self._execute(name, runner, self._state.start_capability)

    def _execute(
        self, name: str, runner: CapabilityRunner, commit: Callable[..., State]
    ) -> State:
        timeout = (
            supervisor_settings(self._root).capability_timeouts.get(name, 10800)
            if self._timeout_seconds is _DEFAULT_TIMEOUT
            else validate_capability_timeout(self._timeout_seconds)
        )
        attempt, session = self._begin(name, commit, None)
        try:
            execution = runner.run(
                CapabilityRequest(
                    name=name,
                    root=self._root,
                    batch_id=self._store.read()["batch"]["id"],
                    attempt_id=attempt["id"],
                    session=session,
                    timeout_seconds=timeout,
                )
            )
        except Exception as error:
            assert attempt["session_id"] is not None
            self.finish(
                name,
                attempt["id"],
                CapabilityExecution(
                    success=False,
                    session_id=attempt["session_id"],
                    detail=f"runner raised {type(error).__name__}: {error}; "
                    f"retry {name} explicitly",
                ),
            )
            raise
        return self.finish(name, attempt["id"], execution)

    def _begin(
        self,
        name: str,
        commit: Callable[..., State],
        expected_revision: int | None,
    ) -> tuple[CapabilityAttempt, SessionPaths]:
        identity = process_identity(os.getpid())
        if identity is None:
            raise RuntimeError("cannot observe the current process identity")
        started_at = _timestamp(self._clock())
        attempt: CapabilityAttempt = {
            "id": str(uuid4()),
            "status": "running",
            "started_at": started_at,
            "finished_at": None,
            "session_id": str(uuid4()),
            "detail": None,
        }
        state = commit(name, attempt, expected_revision=expected_revision)
        assert attempt["session_id"] is not None
        session = self._create_session(
            name, attempt["session_id"], identity, started_at
        )
        publish_session_metric(
            self._paths,
            session,
            SessionMetric(
                schema_version=1,
                kind="capability",
                run_id=self._run_id,
                session_id=attempt["session_id"],
                batch_id=state["batch"]["id"],
                prd=None,
                phase_launched=None,
                capability=name,
                phase_end=None,
                decision=None,
                started_at=started_at,
                finished_at=None,
                wall_seconds=None,
                model=None,
                usage=None,
            ),
        )
        return attempt, session

    def _create_session(
        self,
        name: str,
        session_id: str,
        identity: ProcessIdentity,
        started_at: str,
    ) -> SessionPaths:
        session = create_session(
            self._paths,
            SessionMetadata(
                schema_version=1,
                run_id=self._run_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                agent=f"capability:{name}",
                pid=identity.pid,
                process_start=identity.started,
                started_at=started_at,
            ),
        )
        os.close(
            os.open(
                session.raw, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600
            )
        )
        return session

    def _finalize(self, state: State, name: str, session: SessionPaths) -> None:
        attempt = state["batch"]["capabilities"][name]["attempts"][-1]
        assert attempt["finished_at"] is not None
        try:
            metadata = parse_session_metadata(json.loads(session.metadata.read_text()))
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            if session.root.exists():
                return  # ponytail: partial evidence stays as-is; state records it.
            # The owner died before creating evidence; record the failure here.
            identity = process_identity(os.getpid())
            if identity is None:
                raise RuntimeError("cannot observe the current process identity")
            self._create_session(
                name, session.root.name, identity, attempt["started_at"]
            )
            metadata = parse_session_metadata(json.loads(session.metadata.read_text()))
        publish_session_metric(
            self._paths,
            session,
            SessionMetric(
                schema_version=1,
                kind="capability",
                run_id=metadata.run_id,
                session_id=metadata.session_id,
                batch_id=state["batch"]["id"],
                prd=None,
                phase_launched=None,
                capability=name,
                phase_end=None,
                decision=attempt["status"],
                started_at=attempt["started_at"],
                finished_at=attempt["finished_at"],
                wall_seconds=(
                    datetime.fromisoformat(attempt["finished_at"])
                    - datetime.fromisoformat(attempt["started_at"])
                ).total_seconds(),
                model=None,
                usage=None,
            ),

### 12.3 Decision ordering

After a session exits:

1. Read state and compare revision/mtime to the pre-launch snapshot.
2. A valid productive state transition wins over provider exit noise.
3. Honor requested pause.
4. A drained workflow with a required `pending`, stale `running`, or `failed`
   post-drain capability follows the capability contract; failure exits nonzero
   and never reopens a completed workflow phase.
5. Empty next phase plus all required capabilities `succeeded` or `skipped`
   means the batch is complete.
6. A changed state with another phase means continue.
7. With no state progress, inspect normalized rate-limit/failure summary.
8. Wait for a bounded provider rate limit when reset information is credible.
9. Retry a bounded connectivity/session death.
10. Detect repeated identical phase fingerprints.
11. Park the selected PRD or halt a bootstrap/systemic failure.

This preserves the strongest current property: workflow state wins over prose
and incidental process exit status.

### 12.4 Run/TUI relationship

`ovcaq run` starts the supervisor as the owned background process and attaches
the TUI on an interactive terminal. `q` detaches; `p` requests a boundary
pause; `s` confirms and stops the process group. `ovcaq run --no-tui` keeps the
supervisor in the foreground for CI/headless use. `ovcaq attach` never starts a
second supervisor.

## 13. TUI migration

Move tracon only after the shared state, registry, event, and driver types are
stable.

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from tests.runtime.test_supervisor import Step, add_capability, drain, harness

from ovcaq.events.model import FailureClass
from ovcaq.runtime.decision import DecisionKind, progress_fingerprint
from ovcaq.state.schema import Notice, State

NOTICE: Notice = {
    "site": "review_cap",
    "detail": "Inspect review",
    "created_at": "2026-10-02T12:00:00Z",
}


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "failures",
    [
        [FailureClass.AGENT, FailureClass.CONNECTIVITY, FailureClass.RATE_LIMIT],
        [FailureClass.RATE_LIMIT, FailureClass.AGENT, FailureClass.CONNECTIVITY],
    ],
)
def test_alternating_failure_classes_cannot_extend_the_phase_limit(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, failures: list[FailureClass]
) -> None:
    h = harness(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    repeats: list[int] = []
    h.driver.on_line = lambda _: repeats.append(
        h.store.read()["recovery"]["phase_repeats"]
    )
    h.driver.steps = [Step(failure, reset_seconds=1) for failure in failures]
    outcome = h.supervisor().run()
    assert outcome.sessions_attempted == 3
    assert outcome.decision.kind in {DecisionKind.HALT, DecisionKind.PAUSE}
    assert repeats == [0, 1, 2]
    state = h.store.read()
    assert state["recovery"]["phase_repeats"] == 3
    assert state["recovery"]["phase_fingerprint"] == progress_fingerprint(state)
    assert len(h.driver.requests) == 3


@pytest.mark.parametrize("boundary", ["workflow", "capability", "empty", "complete"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("site", ["review_cap", "operator-check"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "control", ["attention", "pause_requested", "phase", "next_phase"]
)
def test_committed_controls_block_every_startup_boundary(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    boundary: str,
    control: str,
    site: str,
) -> None:
    h = harness(tmp_path, monkeypatch)

    def prepare(state: State) -> None:
        if boundary != "workflow":
            drain(state, completed=boundary != "empty")
        if boundary in {"capability", "empty"}:
            add_capability(state)
        if control == "attention":
            state["control"]["attention"] = deepcopy(NOTICE)
            state["control"]["attention"]["site"] = site
        elif control == "pause_requested":
            state["control"].update(pause_requested=True, pause_reason=NOTICE)
        else:
            state["work"][control] = "paused"

    h.store.transaction(prepare)
    before = h.store.read()
    outcome = h.supervisor().run()
    assert outcome.sessions_attempted == 0
    assert outcome.decision.kind == (
        DecisionKind.HALT if control == "attention" else DecisionKind.PAUSE
    )
    assert (outcome.exit_code != 0) == (control == "attention")
    assert h.driver.requests == h.runner.requests == []
    after = h.store.read()
    assert after["control"] == before["control"]
    assert after["work"] == before["work"]
    assert after["batch"]["capabilities"] == before["batch"]["capabilities"]
    assert after["batch"]["status"] != "completed"

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from tests.runtime.test_supervisor import Step, add_capability, drain, harness

from ovcaq.runtime.decision import DecisionKind, SupervisorDecision
from ovcaq.runtime.session import reconcile_metrics
from ovcaq.state.schema import State, new_state


@pytest.mark.parametrize("started", [False, True])
def test_run_commits_batch_identity_before_first_metric_and_preserves_work(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, started: bool
) -> None:
    identifiers = []
    for index in range(2):
        location = tmp_path / str(index)
        location.mkdir()
        h = harness(location, monkeypatch)

        def prepare(state: State, root: Path = h.root) -> None:
            if not started:
                state["batch"] = new_state(repo_root=root)["batch"]
            else:
                state["batch"]["started_at"] = "2026-08-26T10:00:00Z"
            state["work"]["extensions"] = {"test/work": [1, 2]}
            state["review"]["extensions"] = {"test/review": [3, 4]}

        before = h.store.transaction(prepare)
        expected_time = (
            before["batch"]["started_at"] if started else h.clock.now().isoformat()
        )
        snapshot = h.root / "first-metric-state.json"
        h.driver.steps = [
            Step(
                code=f"Path({str(snapshot)!r}).write_text(Path({str(h.store.path)!r}).read_text())",
                effect=lambda h=h: h.store.transaction(
                    lambda state: state["control"].update(pause_requested=True)
                ),
            )
        ]
        outcome = h.supervisor().run()
        assert outcome.exit_code == 0 and outcome.sessions_attempted == 1
        observed = json.loads(snapshot.read_text())
        batch = observed["batch"]
        assert batch["id"].strip() and batch["status"] == "running"
        assert datetime.fromisoformat(batch["started_at"]) == datetime.fromisoformat(
            expected_time
        )
        if started:
            assert batch == before["batch"]
        for key in ("work", "tasks", "review"):
            assert observed[key] == before[key] == h.store.read()[key]
        assert batch["completed_prds"] == before["batch"]["completed_prds"]
        (metric,) = reconcile_metrics(h.paths)
        assert metric.batch_id == batch["id"]
        identifiers.append(batch["id"])
    if not started:
        assert len(set(identifiers)) == 2


@pytest.mark.parametrize("empty_optional", [False, True])
def test_terminal_drain_archives_completed_batch_with_injected_time(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, empty_optional: bool
) -> None:
    h = harness(tmp_path, monkeypatch)

    def prepare(state: State) -> None:
        drain(state, completed=not empty_optional)
        if empty_optional:
            add_capability(state)
            state["batch"]["capabilities"]["audit"]["required"] = False

    before = h.store.transaction(prepare)
    supervisor = h.supervisor()
    outcome = supervisor.run()
    result = h.store.read()
    assert outcome.exit_code == 0 and outcome.decision.kind == DecisionKind.COMPLETE
    assert outcome.sessions_attempted == 0 and h.runner.requests == []
    assert result["batch"]["status"] == "completed"
    assert datetime.fromisoformat(result["batch"]["completed_at"]) == h.clock.now()
    for key in ("work", "tasks", "review"):
        assert result[key] == before[key]
    assert result["batch"]["completed_prds"] == before["batch"]["completed_prds"]
    archive = h.paths.reports / "batch-1-state-final.json"
    assert json.loads(archive.read_text()) == result
    original = archive.read_bytes(), archive.stat().st_mtime_ns
    assert supervisor.apply(SupervisorDecision(DecisionKind.COMPLETE, "done")) is False
    assert h.store.read() == result
    assert (archive.read_bytes(), archive.stat().st_mtime_ns) == original


def test_empty_drain_skips_required_capability_using_injected_time(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    h = harness(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    h.store.transaction(add_capability)
    before = h.store.transaction(lambda state: drain(state, completed=False))
    outcome = h.supervisor().run()
    result = h.store.read()
    assert outcome.exit_code == 0 and outcome.sessions_attempted == 0
    assert h.runner.requests == [] and h.driver.requests == []
    assert result["batch"]["capabilities"]["audit"] == {
        **before["batch"]["capabilities"]["audit"],
        "required": False,
        "status": "skipped",
    }
    assert result["batch"]["status"] == "completed"
    assert datetime.fromisoformat(result["batch"]["completed_at"]) == h.clock.now()
    assert (
        json.loads((h.paths.reports / "batch-1-state-final.json").read_text()) == result
    )

from __future__ import annotations

)

def test_signal_persists_stop_with_injected_clock_and_preserves_existing_intent(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    preserve: bool,
    number: signal.Signals,
    clock_date: str,
) -> None:
    h = harness(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    h.clock.current = datetime.fromisoformat(clock_date)
    h.store.transaction(seed_history)
    h.driver.steps = [
        Step(code="print('ready', flush=True); import time; time.sleep(10)")
    ]
    before: list[State] = []

    def stop(line: str) -> None:
        if preserve:
            h.store.transaction(preserve_intent)
        before.append(h.store.read())
        threading.Timer(0.05, os.kill, args=(os.getpid(), number)).start()

    h.driver.on_line = stop
    assert h.supervisor().run().exit_code == 128 + number
    state = h.store.read()
    assert state["control"]["pause_requested"] is True
    if preserve:
        assert state["control"]["pause_reason"] == before[0]["control"]["pause_reason"]
    else:
        notice = state["control"]["pause_reason"]
        assert notice is not None and notice["site"] == "operator_stop"
        assert str(int(number)) in notice["detail"]
        assert datetime.fromisoformat(notice["created_at"]) == h.clock.now()
    for section in ("work", "recovery", "batch", "tasks", "review"):
        assert state[section] == before[0][section]
    assert state["control"]["attention"] == before[0]["control"]["attention"]

    assert restarted.sessions_attempted == 0
    assert h.driver.requests == []

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("arguments", "required_argument"),
    [
        pytest.param(("run",), "--no-tui", id="run-requires-no-tui"),
        pytest.param(
            ("capability", "retry"),
            "name",
            id="capability-retry-requires-name",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_incomplete_lifecycle_commands_fail_with_json_usage_errors(
    tmp_path: Path,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
    arguments: tuple[str, ...],
    required_argument: str,
) -> None:
    _success(_invoke(tmp_path, capsys, "init"))
    before = _state(tmp_path)
    failure = _failure(_invoke(tmp_path, capsys, *arguments))
    assert failure["error"]["code"] == "usage"
    assert required_argument in failure["error"]["message"].lower()
    assert _state(tmp_path) == before


def test_stop_without_published_identity_fails_closed(
    tmp_path: Path, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]
) -> None:
    _success(_invoke(tmp_path, capsys, "init"))
    before = _state(tmp_path)
    first = _failure(_invoke(tmp_path, capsys, "stop"))
    second = _failure(_invoke(tmp_path, capsys, "stop"))
    assert first["error"]["code"] == second["error"]["code"] != "usage"
    assert _state(tmp_path) == before

+from __future__ import annotations

+from packaging_support import InstalledWheel
+from tests.packaging.test_installed_supervisor_cli import (
+    _assert_process_stopped,
+    _project,
+    _run,
+    _running,
+    _state,
+    _success,
+    _workflow,
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("stop", ["SIGINT", "SIGTERM", "command"])
+def test_installed_stop_requires_resume_before_a_fresh_process_can_launch(
+    installed_wheel: InstalledWheel, tmp_path: Path, stop: str
+) -> None:
+    root, cwd, environment = _project(installed_wheel, tmp_path)
+    before = _state(root)
+    number = signal.SIGINT if stop == "SIGINT" else signal.SIGTERM
+    with _running(installed_wheel, environment, root, cwd) as (process, driver_pid):
+        if stop == "command":
+            assert _success(_run(installed_wheel, environment, cwd, "stop")) == {
+                "pid": process.pid,
+                "signal": 15,
+            }
+        else:
+            process.send_signal(number)
+        stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=10)
+        assert process.returncode == 128 + number, stdout + stderr
+        _assert_process_stopped(driver_pid)
+        marker = root / "invocations.jsonl"
+        row = json.loads(marker.read_text().splitlines()[0])
+        assert row["grandchild"] is not None
+        _assert_process_stopped(row["grandchild"])
+    state = _state(root)
+    assert state["control"]["pause_requested"] is True
+    notice = state["control"]["pause_reason"]
+    assert notice["site"] == "operator_stop" and str(int(number)) in notice["detail"]
+    assert _workflow(state) == _workflow(before)
+    invocations = marker.read_bytes()
+    _success(_run(installed_wheel, environment, cwd, "run", "--no-tui"))
+    assert marker.read_bytes() == invocations
+    assert _state(root)["control"]["pause_requested"] is True
+    _success(_run(installed_wheel, environment, cwd, "resume"))
+    _success(_run(installed_wheel, environment, cwd, "run", "--no-tui"))
+    assert len(marker.read_text().splitlines()) == 4
+    assert _state(root)["batch"]["status"] == "completed"

+    assert len(marker.read_text().splitlines()) == 4

"""Requirements-only capability execution and timeout regressions."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from tests.runtime.test_capability_lifecycle import _workflow
from tests.runtime.test_supervisor import Harness, add_capability, drain, harness, rows

from ovcaq.config import supervisor_settings
from ovcaq.runtime.capability import (
    CapabilityExecution,
    CapabilityRequest,
    CapabilityService,
)
from ovcaq.runtime.decision import DecisionKind
from ovcaq.runtime.session import reconcile_metrics


@dataclass
class EvidenceRunner:
    h: Harness
    error: Exception | None = None
    detail: str | None = None
    requests: list[CapabilityRequest] = field(default_factory=list)
    aggregates: list[list[dict[str, object]]] = field(default_factory=list)

    def run(self, request: CapabilityRequest) -> CapabilityExecution:
        self.requests.append(request)
        self.aggregates.append(
            rows(self.h.paths.metrics) if self.h.paths.metrics.exists() else []
        )
        current = self.h.store.read()["batch"]["capabilities"][request.name]
        assert current["status"] == "running"
        assert current["attempts"][-1]["id"] == request.attempt_id
        assert current["attempts"][-1]["session_id"] == request.session.root.name
        request.session.raw.write_text('{"event":"runner evidence"}\n')
        if self.error is not None:
            raise self.error
        return CapabilityExecution(True, request.session.root.name, self.detail)


def service(h: Harness, **options: object) -> CapabilityService:
    return CapabilityService(
        h.root,
        store=h.store,
        paths=h.paths,
        run_id="explicit-retry",
        clock=h.clock.now,
        **options,
    )


def ready(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Harness:
    h = harness(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    h.store.transaction(add_capability)
    h.store.transaction(drain)
    return h


def failed_attempt(h: Harness, name: str = "audit") -> dict[str, object]:
    lifecycle = service(h, timeout_seconds=17)
    attempt = lifecycle.start(name)
    assert attempt["session_id"] is not None
    lifecycle.finish(
        name,
        attempt["id"],
        CapabilityExecution(False, attempt["session_id"], "seed failure; retry audit"),
    )
    return h.store.read()["batch"]["capabilities"][name]["attempts"][0]


def configure(h: Harness, user: str, project: str) -> None:
    user_path = h.root.parent / "user-config/ovcaq/config.toml"
    user_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    user_path.write_text(user)
    (h.root / "ovcaq.toml").write_text(project)
    h.settings = supervisor_settings(h.root, runtime=h.settings.runtime)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", ["pending", "retry"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["audit", "archive"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("user", "project", "expected"),
    [
        (None, None, 10800),
        (79, None, 79),
        (79, 1, 1),
        (79, 86400, 86400),
        (2, None, 2),
        (42, None, 42),
        (79, 1234, 1234),
        (79, 86399, 86399),
    ],
)
def test_capability_request_uses_bounded_configuration_without_agent_route(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    entry: str,
    name: str,
    user: int | None,
    project: int | None,
    expected: int,
) -> None:
    h = ready(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    if name != "audit":
        h.store.transaction(
            lambda state: state["batch"]["capabilities"].update(
                {name: state["batch"]["capabilities"].pop("audit")}
            )
        )
    if entry == "retry":
        failed_attempt(h, name)
    configure(
        h,
        "" if user is None else f"[capabilities.{name}]\ntimeout_seconds={user}\n",
        "[phases.done]\ntimeout_seconds=5\n"
        + (
            ""
            if project is None
            else f"[capabilities.{name}]\ntimeout_seconds={project}\n"
        ),
    )
    runner = EvidenceRunner(h)
    h.runner = runner
    if entry == "pending":
        assert h.supervisor().run().sessions_attempted == 0
    else:
        service(h).retry(name, runner)
    (request,) = runner.requests
    assert request.timeout_seconds == expected
    assert request.name == name
    assert h.driver.requests == []
    assert h.store.read()["batch"]["capabilities"][name]["status"] == "succeeded"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("override", [1, 2, 42, 1234, 10800, 86399, 86400])
def test_explicit_timeout_overrides_project_and_user_values(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    override: int,
) -> None:
    h = ready(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    failed_attempt(h)
    configure(
        h,
        "[capabilities.audit]\ntimeout_seconds=71\n",
        "[capabilities.audit]\ntimeout_seconds=43\n",
    )
    runner = EvidenceRunner(h)
    service(h, timeout_seconds=override).retry("audit", runner)
    (request,) = runner.requests
    assert request.timeout_seconds == override
    assert h.driver.requests == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("user", "project", "override", "expected"),
    [("true", "41", None, 41), ("false", "-1", 59, 59)],
    ids=["project-over-invalid-user", "explicit-over-invalid-project-and-user"],
)
def test_valid_higher_priority_timeout_supersedes_invalid_lower_values(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    user: str,
    project: str,
    override: int | None,
    expected: int,
) -> None:
    h = ready(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    failed_attempt(h)
    user_path = h.root.parent / "user-config/ovcaq/config.toml"
    user_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    user_path.write_text(f"[capabilities.audit]\ntimeout_seconds={user}\n")
    (h.root / "ovcaq.toml").write_text(
        f"[capabilities.audit]\ntimeout_seconds={project}\n"
    )
    runner = EvidenceRunner(h)
    options = {} if override is None else {"timeout_seconds": override}
    state = service(h, **options).retry("audit", runner)
    (request,) = runner.requests
    assert request.timeout_seconds == expected
    assert state["batch"]["capabilities"]["audit"]["status"] == "succeeded"
    assert h.driver.requests == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("source", ["user", "project", "explicit"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "value", [True, False, 0, -1, 86401, 1.5, float("inf"), float("nan"), "79", ""]
)
def test_invalid_timeout_is_rejected_before_runner_launch(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    source: str,
    value: object,
) -> None:
    h = ready(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    failed_attempt(h)
    runner = EvidenceRunner(h)
    literal = json.dumps(value) if isinstance(value, str) else str(value).lower()
    config = f"[capabilities.audit]\ntimeout_seconds={literal}\n"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        if source == "explicit":
            service(h, timeout_seconds=value).retry("audit", runner)
        else:
            configure(
                h,
                config if source == "user" else "",
                config if source == "project" else "",
            )
            service(h).retry("audit", runner)
    assert runner.requests == []
    assert h.driver.requests == []


class IntegerLikeTimeout:
    def __int__(self) -> int:
        return 79

    def __index__(self) -> int:
        return 79


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "value",
    [None, [], {}, IntegerLikeTimeout()],
    ids=["null", "list", "mapping", "integer-like"],
)
def test_explicit_timeout_rejects_noninteger_objects_before_runner_launch(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    value: object,
) -> None:
    h = ready(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    failed_attempt(h)
    runner = EvidenceRunner(h)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        service(h, timeout_seconds=value).retry("audit", runner)
    assert runner.requests == [] and h.driver.requests == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", ["pending", "retry"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(

    [
        LookupError("archive backend unavailable"),

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import timedelta

import pytest
from tests.runtime.test_decision import _NOW, _POLICY, _attempt, _decision, _state

from ovcaq.events.model import FailureClass
from ovcaq.runtime.decision import (
    DecisionKind,
    RetryState,
    progress_fingerprint,
    snapshot,
)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("repeats", [0, 2, 3])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "failure", [FailureClass.PERMISSION, FailureClass.AUTHENTICATION]
)
def test_permission_and_authentication_halt_even_at_the_shared_repeat_limit(
    repeats: int, failure: FailureClass
) -> None:
    state = _state()
    state["recovery"].update(
        phase_fingerprint=progress_fingerprint(state), phase_repeats=repeats
    )
    before = snapshot(state)
    decision = _decision(before, _attempt(before, failure))
    assert decision.kind == DecisionKind.HALT
    assert decision.next_phase_repeats == repeats + 1
    assert decision.wait_seconds is None
    assert decision.capability is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize("repeats", [0, 2, 3])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "failure,prd,retries",
    [
        (
            FailureClass.CONNECTIVITY,
            "00001-feature.md",
            RetryState(connectivity=_POLICY.connectivity_retries),
        ),
        (
            FailureClass.RATE_LIMIT,
            "00001-feature.md",
            RetryState(rate_limit=_POLICY.rate_limit_retries),
        ),
        (FailureClass.AGENT, None, RetryState(died=_POLICY.died_retries)),
    ],
    ids=["connectivity", "rate_limit", "bootstrap_death"],
)
def test_exhausted_class_budgets_keep_their_terminal_halt_at_shared_boundaries(
    repeats: int, failure: FailureClass, prd: str | None, retries: RetryState
) -> None:
    state = _state()
    state["work"]["prd"] = prd
    state["recovery"].update(
        phase_fingerprint=progress_fingerprint(state), phase_repeats=repeats
    )
    before = snapshot(state)
    result = _attempt(before, failure, reset_at=_NOW + timedelta(seconds=1))
    decision = _decision(before, result, retries)
    assert decision.kind == DecisionKind.HALT
    assert decision.next_phase_repeats == repeats + 1
    assert decision.wait_seconds is None
    assert decision.capability is None

[BOB] 🟠 New regression: `_run_capability` swallows every exception once the capability's status is `failed`, and that includes `SupervisorSignal` (an `Exception` subclass, process.py:33). If SIGTERM, SIGINT or `ovcaq stop` lands during a capability run, `_execute` (capability.py:351) records "runner raised SupervisorSignal" and re-raises; `_run_capability` then drops it, the loop halts on attention, and `run()` returns exit 1 instead of 128+N with no `operator_stop` pause. The base code re-raised. The same catch also hides finalize/evidence errors that occur after a failed attempt is committed. No test sends a signal during a capability run. | File: src/ovcaq/runtime/supervisor.py:309 | Task: 12
[BOB] 🟠 `_loop` now wraps `_attempt` and `apply` in `except _STATE_ERRORS`, and that tuple includes bare `OSError` (supervisor.py:80). So these all become the durable attention "Supervisor state operation failed; inspect state before restarting.": a missing or non-executable agent binary (`Popen` FileNotFoundError/PermissionError, process.py:118), session-evidence I/O, config reads, and PRD file moves in `park`. The real message is dropped, and every later run halts until someone edits state by hand. At base the error propagated with its message. This also breaks the premise of the settled F23 deferral ("spawn failure remains explicit"). Only `run_once` is tested with a launch OSError (test_supervisor.py:443); `run()` is not. | File: src/ovcaq/runtime/supervisor.py:240 | Task: 11
[BOB] 🟡 The shared repeat limit parks a PRD for a provider-wide failure. When the limit is hit while the connectivity or rate-limit budget still allows WAIT, `decide` falls through to PARK whenever a PRD is active. Two traced cases with limit 5: conn, conn, conn, rate_limit, rate_limit gives PARK; `connectivity_retries=10` parks on the 5th outage. Running out of the same class budget gives HALT instead (test_decision_terminal_failures.py:65), and plan §12.3 step 11 reserves halt for systemic failures. Two such parks trigger the systemic-park pause. The at-limit kind is not pinned by any test (hedged at test_decision_retry_bound.py:60). | File: src/ovcaq/runtime/decision.py:283 | Task: 10
[BOB] 🟡 The supplied `SupervisorSettings.capability_timeouts` is never read. The supervisor builds `CapabilityService` without a timeout (supervisor.py:287), and the service re-reads disk through `supervisor_settings(self._root)`. This repeats F16's flaw for the new field. It also re-parses runtime, policy and phase config on every attempt, so an unrelated config error blocks capability runs. Tests pass only because the disk config matches the supplied settings (test_capability_execution_contract.py:82). | File: src/ovcaq/runtime/capability.py:335 | Task: 12
[BOB] 🟡 Same bug as F07, in a sibling path: `request_pause` always overwrites `pause_reason` (with None when there is no `--reason`). So `ovcaq pause` during a review-cap or systemic-park pause erases the routing key that workflow/resume.py:17 reads. `pause --reason X` replaces that key, and `resume` now keeps the replacement for good. `_record_stop` already guards this case (supervisor.py:190). | File: src/ovcaq/state/commands.py:454 | Task: 10
[BOB] 🟡 New tests hedge exactly the policy they were added to pin: `kind in {PARK, HALT}` (test_decision_retry_bound.py:60), `kind in {RETRY, WAIT}` (test_decision_retry_bound.py:87), and `kind in {HALT, PAUSE}` (test_supervisor_boundary_policy.py:38). Every parameter makes the exact kind knowable. These are not in the mech-check table. | File: tests/runtime/test_decision_retry_bound.py:60 | Task: 10
